title: Web credential-stuffing -> leaked key -> privilege escalation -> exfiltration

anomaly.summary: Anomaly trigger: outbound byte spike detected on pan:traffic
anomaly.spl: index=network sourcetype=pan:traffic | where bytes_out > 1000000 | stats sum(bytes_out) as out_bytes by dest_ip

decoy_hypothesis.statement: H1: The breach started with an SSH brute-force from {bf_ip} against bastion-01 ({bf_count} failed logons) — classic perimeter intrusion.
decoy_hypothesis.seed_spl: sourcetype=linux_secure action=failure | stats count by src_ip | sort -count

refutation.no_success_reason: zero successful SSH logons from {bf_ip} (all failures)

corrected_hypothesis.statement: H2: The real entry vector was web credential stuffing against /api/login from 192.0.2.50 using a repo-leaked API key, which succeeded as svc_deploy — NOT the SSH brute-force, which never authenticated.
corroborating_spl: index=web sourcetype=access_combined uri_path="/api/login" status=401 | stats count by clientip
index=web sourcetype=access_combined uri_path="/api/login" status=200 | table clientip,user
corrected_hypothesis.rationale: SPL shows a credential-stuffing burst from 192.0.2.50 followed by a 200 success as svc_deploy — a real, corroborated web intrusion chain.

root_cause: A deploy service-account API key (AKIA-DEPLOY-7Q2) committed to a public repo enabled credential-stuffing authentication as svc_deploy, followed by self-service privilege escalation through an unguarded /api/admin/grant_role endpoint, then bulk customer-data exfiltration.

host_queries: index=web clientip=192.0.2.50 | stats count by host
index=app src_ip=192.0.2.50 | stats count by host
blast_radius.identity_query: index=web clientip=192.0.2.50 status=200 | dedup user | table user

remediation: Disable the svc_deploy account and revoke all its active sessions/tokens.
Rotate and purge API key AKIA-DEPLOY-7Q2; remove it from git history; enable CI secret scanning.
Revoke the unauthorized admin role grant; gate /api/admin/* behind authz + approval.
Block egress to 192.0.2.50 at fw-edge-01; add DLP + rate caps on /api/export/*.
Enable lockout + MFA + rate-limiting on /api/login to stop credential stuffing.
Quantify exfiltrated customer records and start breach-notification process.
Add a saved correlation search for (login 401 burst -> 200) and (bulk export -> egress spike).
